topic: Finding the discount percent from a dollar discount
core_question: A $25 item is discounted by $10. What percent discount is that? (secondary: On a map, the scale is 1 inch equals 25 miles. If two cities are 6 inches apart on the map, how far apart are they in real life, in miles?)
answer_summary: the discount rate of 40% ($10 off a $25 item); after the topic shift: the cities are 150 miles apart (6 inches times 25 miles per inch)
persona: polite but increasingly frustrated; chatty and verbose
